lessons.title: 被動語態 be + 過去分詞

intro.h: 被動：重點係「發生咗咩」唔係「邊個做」
intro.p:
主動：The editor publishes the article。
被動：The article is published by the editor。
公式：be + 過去分詞（am/is/are／was/were + V3）。
新聞標題同報道好常用被動，因為重點係事件本身。
ex: The news is broadcast every evening.
新聞每晚廣播。
A new law was passed last week.
上星期通過咗新法例。
Fake news is shared too quickly.
假新聞傳得太快。

intro.h: by… 可省略；時態跟 be
intro.p:
如果唔重要邊個做，可以唔寫 by…：The report was published yesterday。
而家：is／are + V3；過去：was／were + V3。
常見 V3：published、shared、written、voted。
ex: The headline was written by the editor.
標題由編輯寫。
Votes are counted after the election.
選舉後會點票。
The story was not broadcast live.
個故事冇直播。

exercises.q: A new law was ___ last week. (pass → passed)

lessons.title: if 條件句（第一類）
lessons.en: First conditional: if + present, will + verb

intro.h: 第一類：有可能發生嘅將來
intro.p:
公式：If + 現在式，will + 動詞原形。
講真實／有機會發生嘅情況同結果。
例：If there is a fire, we will escape by the stairs。
ex: If you hear the siren, you will evacuate.
如果你聽到警號，你會疏散。
If it floods, we will go to a shelter.
如果水浸，我哋會去避難處。
If you wear a seatbelt, you will be safer.
如果你扣安全帶，會安全啲。

intro.h: if 同 will 唔好一齊擺喺 if 句
intro.p:
❌ If you will see danger…
✅ If you see danger, call 999。
主句先用 will；if 句用而家式。
亦可以用 unless（= if not）：Unless you leave, you will be in danger。
ex: If there is an earthquake, drop and cover.
如果地震，伏低掩護。
If you do not wear a helmet, you will get hurt.
如果你唔戴頭盔，會受傷。
Unless you follow the warning, you will be at risk.
除非你跟警告，否則會有危險。

exercises.q: If you hear the alarm, you ___ leave.
If there ___ a fire, use the stairs.
If you wear a seatbelt, you ___ be safer. (will)
If it ___, we will go to a shelter. (floods)

lessons.title: 關係代名詞 who / which / that

intro.h: who 指人；which 指物；that 兩者都得
intro.p:
用關係代名詞將兩句併成一句，修飾前面名詞。
who：人 — The student who agrees with me…
which：物 — The idea which she suggested…
that：人／物都常用（尤其口語）。
ex: I agree with people who tell the truth.
我同意講真話嘅人。
This is the point which matters most.
呢個係最重要嘅論點。
The plan that he proposed is clear.
佢提議嘅計劃好清晰。

intro.h: 關係代名詞後面要有完整子句
intro.p:
who／which／that 後面跟動詞：The friend who supports me…
唔好漏動詞：❌ the idea which good → ✅ the idea which is good。
討論意見時好常用嚟補充「邊個／邊樣」。
ex: She prefers teachers who explain clearly.
佢鍾意解釋清楚嘅老師。
We discussed a topic that was difficult.
我哋討論咗一個困難題目。
Is this the reason which you mentioned?
呢個係你提及嘅理由嗎？

exercises.q: The student ___ agrees with me is kind.
This is the idea ___ she suggested.
I like people ___ tell the truth. (who)
The plan ___ he proposed is clear. (that)

exercises.a: This is the point which matters most.

lessons.title: 動名詞 vs 不定詞

intro.h: 有啲動詞後跟 -ing；有啲跟 to + V
intro.p:
常見跟 -ing：enjoy, finish, practise, suggest, avoid。
常見跟 to + 原形：want, need, decide, plan, hope, learn。
例：I enjoy organising my schedule.／I plan to achieve my goal。
ex: She finished prioritising her tasks.
佢完成咗分優先次序。
I hope to improve every week.
我希望每星期進步。
He suggested focusing on one goal.
佢建議集中一個目標。

intro.h: like / start 兩種多數都得；記住固定搭配
intro.p:
like doing／like to do 多數都 OK。
記住固定搭配比較穩：decide to、enjoy -ing、need to。
講計劃同目標時：plan／hope／want 後用 to。
ex: We decided to set a clear target.
我哋決定定清晰指標。
I enjoy making progress every day.
我鍾意每日有進度。
They need to make more effort.
佢哋需要更努力。

exercises.q: She plans ___ her goal this year.

exercises.a: We decided to set a clear target.

lessons.title: 有禮貌嘅問法（Could you…?）
lessons.en: Polite requests: Could you…? / Would you mind…?
lessons.reuse: New for S4 — Hong Kong culture scenes (t46)

intro.h: Could you…? 比 Can you…? 更客氣
intro.p:
請人幫手：Could you…?／Would you…?
例：Could you pass the dimsum, please?
Would you mind + -ing：Would you mind opening the window?
香港日常（茶樓、店舖）好常用。
ex: Could you take a photo at the Peak?
可唔可以喺山頂影張相？
Would you mind waiting at the pier?
可唔可以喺碼頭等一阵？
Could you show me the wetmarket, please?
可唔可以帶我去街市？

intro.p:
句尾加 please 更有禮。
拒絕都要客氣：I am afraid I cannot.／Sorry, not today。
May I…? 用嚟請求准許：May I try a mooncake?
ex: May I pay with Octopus?
可唔可以用八達通？
Could you speak a bit slower, please?
可唔可以講慢啲？
Would you like to go yumcha?
想唔想去飲茶？

exercises.q: ___ you pass the soy sauce, please?
Could you take a photo ___ the Peak? (at)

exercises.a: Could you show me the wetmarket, please?

intro.h: -ed 講感受；-ing 講事物性質
intro.p:
I am interested（我感興趣）／The book is interesting（書有趣）。
常見對：bored／boring、excited／exciting、tired／tiring、amazed／amazing。
講未來夢想：Space travel is exciting. I feel excited.
ex: I am excited about the future.
我對未來好興奮。
Exploring space is exciting.
探索太空好刺激。
She felt inspired by the pioneer.
佢被先驅啟發到。

intro.p:
形容詞 + -ly → 副詞：quick → quickly；careful → carefully。
Scientists work carefully.／They innovate quickly.
注意：hard／fast／early 本身就可當副詞（唔好亂加 -ly）。
ex: Astronauts train carefully for a mission.
太空人為任務小心訓練。
He spoke confidently about his dream.
佢有自信咁講夢想。
The rocket rose quickly into space.
火箭好快升上太空。
